orient.intro: claude-harness installs in three tiers. Nothing here needs all three — pick opt-ins deliberately.

tiers.label: Always-on
tiers.description: Engineering + security rules. No toggle — applies to every session, every project.

tiers.label: Triggered
tiers.description: Skills that wake up when the task shape matches — a UI request, a security review, a PDF.

tiers.label: Opt-in
tiers.description: Memory hooks, caveman mode. Fires on every Edit/Write once wired — earns a deliberate yes.

questions.prompt: Install memory hooks (session checkpoints, project-architecture recall, drift-canary)? They fire on every Edit/Write once wired into settings.json.
Caveman default intensity — only applied if no caveman config exists yet (never overwrites an existing choice).

firstLight.instructions: Open a fresh Claude Code session and type anything (e.g. "hello"). Look for the CAVEMAN MODE ACTIVE banner in the reply — that's the SessionStart hook actually firing, not just files sitting on disk.
